Hello

I've just a question considering Kalinda. Are the 2 blood part of the
bleeding action and therefore have only to be paid if the action is
successful or are the 2 blood needed to somehow "activate" her special
ability. Furthermore this is a burn blood effect and as a vampire she
can only burn blood until she reaches zero, so what if she has only 1
blood (or even 0 due to modifiers ) left when the action resolves ?

Thanks

> can only burn blood until she reaches zero, so what if she has only 1

Her updated card text (see the web site) should clear this up:

<Independent>. As a (D) action [that costs 2 blood], Kalinda can bleed with
+1 bleed at +1 stealth. Kalinda cannot commit diablerie.

The two blood was ruled to be a cost by [RTR 23-JUN-1998]

She cannot attempt the action if she cannot pay the cost (as is the
csae for any minion attempting any action). And, if she doesn't have
enough blood to pay the cost when the action resolves (due to
modifiers), then the action "fizzles".
